close_reason: Already fixed: struct fields use short imported names (HashMap<String, Mdn>, HashMap<Id, Mdn>) not fully-qualified paths. Issue description was stale.
description: MdnSendResult and MdnParseResult (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs:17-33) use fully-qualified paths (std::collections::HashMap<jmap_types::Id, ...>) in their public field type positions despite the file already importing HashMap and Id at lines 7-10. This inconsistency is visible in generated docs and to downstream readers. Use the imported names in the field declarations.
title: mdn.rs: fully-qualified types in public struct fields
